sources.note: NYC minimum wage $17.00/hour from Jan 1, 2026 (NYS Department of Labor). Unloading Tony's truck: 3 h x $17 = $51; a night shift at the register: 6 h x $17 = $102.

Game assumption: $100 once every 4 weeks — a payday transfer to savings (pay yourself first), the same pace as stage 4's once-a-month action; it holds chapter 1 at the stage-4 length on weekly turns (plan 5A, WeeklyPacingTests).
Most affordable Brooklyn neighborhoods by average 1-bedroom rent: Crown Heights $1,973, Bedford-Stuyvesant $2,182, Flatbush $2,220. Chose $1,900 for a studio in one of them.
Jamaica, Queens averages (Dec 2025): studio $1,752, one-bedroom $2,208. Chose $2,300 for a one-bedroom apartment.
Design rule (spec 3a): food, transit and essentials grow 10% a chapter, compounded from the chapter-1 values and rounded to the cent.
Rooms in Bronx 10466 listed at $1,000-$1,250/mo; Zumper Bronx room average $1,700 (https://www.zumper.com/rent-research/the-bronx-ny). Chose $1,100 for a shared starter room.
OMNY 7-day fare cap $35 from Jan 4, 2026; monthly = 35 x 52 / 12 = $151.67, rounded to $152.
USDA Thrifty Food Plan Jan 2026, single adult male 20-50: $311.70/mo (official reports: https://www.fns.usda.gov/cnpp/usda-food-plans-cost-food-monthly-reports).
NYC app delivery minimum pay $22.13/hour from Apr 1, 2026 (excludes tips). Game price $26/hour adds a $3.87/hour tips assumption.
Game assumptions for balance; taxRate 25% is a budgeting reserve per spec, not a tax calculation.

BizBuySell Insight Report 2026: average cash-flow multiple 2.7x at a $350k median sale; by size about 2.0x under $500k of earnings, 3.3x at $1-2M, 5.3x at $5-50M (https://lonelyentrepreneur.com/founder-business-valuation/). topMultiple 8.0 above $50M is a game assumption.
Carta: median share sold is 19.5% at seed, 18% at Series A, 15% at Series B. Game uses 20% a round.
Game assumption: a listed company trades at 15x yearly operating profit; tuned by the stage-3 balance tests.
